title: Shadow puppet (wayang kulit), a female figure
collection: Cooper Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum, 1935-15-1, given by Mrs. Henry J. Post
processing: Cut out at full resolution: paper and its cast shadows by luminance and chroma, the punched holes by the dark paper seen through them. figure.webp is mirrored (the audience's side of the screen) and fitted to 1024 x 2048 with the rod's end at the bottom centre; figure-painted.webp is the unmirrored painted side, 716 x 1600.

title: Fire Kayon, Wayang Kulit, Bali
processing: Cut out from the 3648 x 5472 photograph: the wall by brightness and by blue over red (the copper hide is far redder than the wall seen through its punches), broad glare patches refilled. The horn rod, cut off by the photograph, is carried on below in its own colour. Mirrored and fitted to 1024 x 2048.
